journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

articles.title_en: A general equilibrium approach to carbon permit banking
articles.title_cn: 碳配额银行化的一般均衡方法
articles.abstract_en: We study the general equilibrium effects of carbon permit banking during the transition to a climate-neutral economy by 2050. To this end, we develop an environmental dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model, in which the business sector is regulated by a generic emission trading system (ETS). Firms are authorized to transfer unused permits from one period to the next (banking), but the reverse direction (borrowing) is prohibited. Allowing for positive banking gives firms the opportunity to smooth their permit demand along the business cycle. Applications inspired by recent European Union-ETS regulations underscore the critical role of permit banking in shaping policy outcomes. For example, the 2023 cap reform would result in a more significant reduction in both permit banking and carbon emissions, as well as a 40% to 50% increase in the carbon price compared to pre-reform projections, without substantial additional GDP loss by 2060. Importantly, forgetting about permit banking when assessing cap policies would lead to both a significant underestimation of the total macroeconomic effects and an inaccurate representation of the carbon emission trajectory.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了向气候中和经济转型期间碳配额银行化的一般均衡效应，目标年份为2050年。为此，我们开发了一个环境动态随机一般均衡模型，其中商业部门受到通用排放交易体系（ETS）的监管。企业被授权将未使用的配额从一个时期转移到下一个时期（银行化），但反向操作（借贷）是被禁止的。允许正向银行化给企业提供了在商业周期中平滑其配额需求的机会。受近期欧盟ETS法规启发的应用案例强调了配额银行化在塑造政策结果中的关键作用。例如，2023年的上限改革将导致配额银行化和碳排放的更大减少，以及相比改革前预测，碳价格上升40%至50%，而到2060年不会造成显著的额外GDP损失。重要的是，在评估上限政策时忽略配额银行化将导致对总体宏观经济效应的显著低估以及对碳排放轨迹的不准确描述。

articles.title_en: Compensating against fuel price inflation: Price subsidies or transfers?
articles.title_cn: 应对燃料价格通胀的补偿：价格补贴还是转移支付？
articles.abstract_en: Compensating agents against substantial and sudden shocks requires both targeting tax policies and taking behavioral responses into account. Based on transaction-level data from France, this article exploits quasi-experimental variation provided by 2022 fuel price inflation and excise tax cuts. After disentangling anticipation from price effects, we estimate a price elasticity of fuel demand of −0.31, on average, which varies little with respect to income and location but substantially decreases with fuel spending, in absolute value. Using targeted transfers only achieves imperfect compensation, yet a budget-constrained policy-maker seeking to alleviate excessive losses relative to income prefers income-based transfers to price subsidies.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对重大且突然的冲击进行补偿，既需要针对性的税收政策，也需要考虑行为反应。基于法国的交易级数据，本文利用了2022年燃料价格通胀和消费税削减提供的准实验变异。在将预期效应与价格效应分离后，我们估计燃料需求的平均价格弹性为−0.31，该弹性随收入和地点的变化不大，但随燃料支出的增加而显著减小（绝对值）。仅使用针对性的转移支付只能实现不完全的补偿，然而，一个预算受限的政策制定者若旨在减轻相对于收入的过度损失，则更倾向于基于收入的转移支付而非价格补贴。

articles.title_en: Heat and humidity on early-life outcomes: Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 热与湿度对早期生命结果的影响：来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: I provide evidence on the detrimental effect of in utero exposure to heat and humidity on children’s health at birth in a middle-income country, Mexico. Humidity affects the body’s ability to regulate heat via perspiration and may thus exacerbate the adverse effects of high temperatures. I link temperature and humidity exposure during pregnancy to individual outcomes regarding 25 million births and stillbirths from 2008 through 2021 using Mexican administrative records. The results show that high wet-bulb temperatures adversely affect birth outcomes. Specifically, each additional day per month with a wet-bulb temperature above 24°C (equivalent to about 40°C at 25% humidity) reduces birth weight by 1.21% and increases the likelihood of preterm birth by 2%. I find that the combined effects of humidity and high temperature on birth outcomes are greater than that of high temperature alone, suggesting that the damaging effects of high temperature can be underestimated when humidity is not accounted for. I also present evidence that the adverse effects of heat on health at birth can be mitigated by adopting air conditioning.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提供了关于在中等收入国家墨西哥，子宫内暴露于热和湿度对新生儿健康不利影响的证据。湿度影响身体通过出汗调节热量的能力，因此可能加剧高温的不利影响。我利用墨西哥行政记录，将怀孕期间的温度和湿度暴露与25年至2008年间约2021万例出生和死产的个体结果联系起来。结果显示，高湿球温度对出生结果产生不利影响。具体而言，每月湿球温度超过24°C（相当于在40湿度下约25%°C）的每一天，会使出生体重减少1.21%，并增加2%的早产可能性。我发现湿度和高温对出生结果的综合影响大于单独高温的影响，这表明在不考虑湿度的情况下，高温的损害效应可能被低估。我还提供了证据表明，采用空调可以减轻高温对出生健康的不利影响。
